设备页的「代理网络」靠透明网关接管局域网设备的流量。在 Windows 上它需要: The "Proxy network" switch on the Devices page relies on a transparent gateway to take over LAN device traffic. On Windows that needs the Npcap driver to send and receive layer-2 frames — without it the switch still flips, but no traffic is actually intercepted.
Npcap 驱动被限制为「仅管理员可访问」—— 「代理网络」会一直报「打开网卡失: Npcap's driver is restricted to administrators only — "Proxy network" will keep failing with "cannot open adapter: access denied". Click at the right to lift the restriction (one UAC prompt).
点「立即安装」后：自动下载官方安装包 → 校验数字签名 → 静默安装。\n· 安:
Clicking "Install now": downloads the official installer → verifies its signature → installs silently.
· Installing a driver needs administrator rights, so UAC will prompt once — click Yes.
· Only the OEM edition of Npcap allows silent install; if it is refused, the wizard opens instead — just click Install. In the wizard please **uncheck** "Restrict Npcap driver's access to Administrators only", otherwise Coast will keep failing with "cannot open adapter: access denied" unless it runs as administrator.
这是本机——它的流量已经由 Coast 自己接管，无需（也不能）代理。: This is your own machine — Coast already handles its traffic, so it neither needs nor can be proxied.
这是当前网络的路由器（网关），劫持它会把整个网络打瘫，因此不可代理。: This is the router (gateway) of the current network. Hijacking it would take the whole network down, so it cannot be proxied.
该设备不在本机任何一张网卡的网段内，透明网关只能劫持与本机同网段的设备，因此不可: This device is not on any subnet of this machine's network adapters. The transparent gateway can only hijack devices on the same subnet, so it cannot be proxied. (With Ethernet and Wi-Fi on two different routers, both subnets count as "the same subnet".)
设备当前离线：拿不到它的 IP/ARP，无法开启代理；等它上线后再开。（已经开着: The device is offline: without its IP/ARP the proxy cannot be enabled — wait until it comes back online. (A proxy that is already on can be turned off at any time.)
